target_attribute: small barnacle-like clusters studding one earlobe

scoring_rule.counts_as_barnacle: Any growth on the face at least partially circumscribed by a black contour line.
scoring_rule.does_not_count: Lighter circles without thickness (confusable with specular highlights), and isolated single circles (confusable with a mole or a water droplet).
scoring_rule.observed_placement: Barnacles generally appear around the ear or on the temples; across every positive render they sit on the cheekbone/temple region rather than on the earlobe the prompt names.
scoring_rule.blinding: none - scored by the author with condition visible
